lines: Back and Forward work in every tab: the arrows, the keys, the mouse buttons and a swipe all take the same step.
A message's menu is shorter, deleting a message asks first, and a long press on a phone opens a sheet made for touch.
Tag several agents in one message and they all start at once. Go with the answer you like, or ask them to discuss.
Long chats have chapters. Lessons show as one quiet mark on a reply instead of lines under every reply.
The Chats sidebar is new, with a plus on each section to start a chat, a channel or an agent.
Other people's private things no longer show in the activity log, in search or in an agent's step details.
